CO1: Write string literals with single, double and triple quotes, escape sequences and raw strings, and predict what a literal contains
CO2: Read characters and substrings of a string with indexes, slices and the in operator, and explain why a string cannot be changed in place
CO3: Put values into text with f-strings, format specifiers, the % operator and format(), and read what each produces
CO4: Test, convert, split, join, pad and trim strings with the string methods, and predict which give a new string and which a Boolean or a number
CO5: Analyze how characters map to code points and bytes, and how the Unicode-aware methods and text encodings affect validation and files
_note: Chapter 8 is language groundwork. The course's approved outcomes are advanced, and none is specific to strings, so these chapter objectives are not claimed to serve one.
